drawing: Dining table 870×820 top; no dimension lines. Each of the 4 legs is an L-shaped corner leg of two boards 725×100 glued/doweled along the edge (dowels 12 in ends of 2,4; Rastex step 1.4): pairs 1+2 (2 legs) and 3+4 (2 legs), the L opening towards the inside corner. Top 5 (870×820) lies ON the legs (Rastex dowels in 5, eccentrics in the legs, step 1.5) with a small overhang on all sides; legs set in from the corners. Apron under the top: царги 6 (720×120, ×2, one pair of opposite sides) and 7 (634×120, ×2, the other pair) joined to each other at the corners with Direkta 8 (step 1.6) and screwed into the inner faces of the L legs with 4x25 screws 13 (step 1.7); 4 brackets 16 fix the apron to the top. Leg tips 14 (glides, 8 = one per leg board) screwed on the leg ends with 3x12 screws 15. Table height ≈ 725 + top thickness. No orthographic front view.
